note: Single source for Cleanup artifact folders. Rust and the Cleanup view both read this file. A folder is confirmed only when a listed file, glob, or directory exists in a parent up to the project root. Without that evidence the row stays uncertain, or is omitted when omitIfUnconfirmed is true. Age is never used. Global caches outside the selected folder are not scanned.
